tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs bzhugs so// dpal ldan stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs brgya'i bdag /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i dpal gyi mgrin pa nas/ /smin grol rab ston legs byas rtsa ba brtan/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa rnams la gsang sgrub skor lnga'am gsum du grags pa las/ dang po bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ maṇḍal mu 'khyud sngon po/ padma 'dab bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte bar tshom bu sngon po gcig 'god/ de'i mthar mchod gtor bshams/ slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po la bya/ sngags yi ge bdun pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la/ bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhir snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dkyus bzhin du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min sogs nas bde mchog lha lnga'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hos mdun bskyed la bstim/ mchod pa byin rlabs la/ oṃ tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇḍal la sa pā ri wa re'i mthar arghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi mchod/ de'i mthar oṃ ā hūm̐ gi nang mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las sogs tshigs bcad kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs la/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar i dam bha lingta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa sngar bzhin/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas mdun bskyed la maṇḍal gsol btab/ rgyun bshags rang nyid la ye shes dbab pa rnams sngar bzhin/

de nas mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa de'i gnas gsum du/ sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga re re bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba nas bzung / dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sgrub cing / de la mchod bstod bdag 'jug blang ba rnams song zin pas/ da slob ma la bya ba'i ngos skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug dga' chen khyed bdag sogs kyi gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma bde mchog tu bskyed pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ spos rol dang sngags brjod/ de ye shes dbab pa yin te dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum na sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga mngon sum bzhin bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsung ba zhu/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum de nas thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor bhrum̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse la raṃ dmar po rlung gi bskyod bzhin pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang bcas pa/ mgrin par bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dmar po/ /snying khar yang bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo sngon po/

de gnyis ka'ang rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse la raṃ dmar po/ lte bar gdan dang bcas pa sngar bzhin bsam/ khyed rang rnams mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i spyi bo'i bde mchog la mos gus byas pas/ de las sku'i bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ dkar po dang baṃ dmar po 'chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas/ sku'i bde mchog yab dkar yum dmar mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang dkar mo'i rnam pa can/ rtsibs kyi rtse rlung gis bskyod pa'i raṃ las me 'od byung ba phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te spyi bo'i lha lnga la phul bas/ de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bsdus/ spyi bo'i lha lnga la thim pas rkyen byas yab yum snyoms par bzhugs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang yab kyi ngo bo'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dang sbyar bas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung / lus thams cad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de bzhin du mgrin pa dang thugs gnyis la yang rigs 'gre/ yang khyed rang gi gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sbyor mtshams nas/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / lus thams cad khengs/ mthar spyi bo'i lha lnga mgrin pa'i lha lnga la thim/ de snying ga'i de la thim/ gnas gsum gyi lte ba'i gdan dang 'khor lo rnams 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de yum la thim/ de je phra je chung nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i gnas lugs de'i ngang la cung zhig 'jog pa zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de dbang bzhi pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad/ rjes gtso bos sogs yig brgyas nongs pa bzod gsol sogs spyi 'dra// ༈ /phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs ni maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi dbus su tshom bu sngon po gcig

mtha' mchod gtor sogs kyis skor ba sngar dang 'dra/ slob dpon gyis skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ skad cig gi padma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa ra tsi ta'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub sgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par lam gyis bsgom/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar/ sngags phreng gis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon bgegs tshar bcad par bsam la/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang zla ba sogs kyi gdan la/ phyag rdor sngar bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ oṃ badzra pa ṇi sa pā ri wa re arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma la byin gyis brlabs la badzra pa ṇi sa pā ri wa re i daṃ sogs lan gsum/ phyi nang bstod pa/ 'dod gsol bya/ de nas maṇḍal gsol 'debs nas bzung ye shes dbab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi bar 'og tu slob ma la bya ba bzhin/ slob dpon gyis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du bya/ de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs sems bskyed brda sprad/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos phyag rdor gsang sgrub la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams bsgrubs zin/ slob ma'i ngos skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rgyun bshags/ slob ma phyag rdor du bskyed la ye shes dbab/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la sogs kyi gsol 'debs lan gsum/ de nas thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung / khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang oṃ badzra ha li dza li sogs kyi mthar a bhya sha ya dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin pa la gsang dbang dang / thugs ka la shes rab ye shes dang / gsum ka'i spro bsdu'i dbang bzhi pa thob cing gsung la sogs pa de dang de'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la re re la ḍā dril dang sngags 'dra/ de ltar dbang bzhi bskur ba la brten nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag pas/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gi padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ bsgom/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las kyang hūm̐ yig gnyis pa dang sngags 'phreng 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du bzhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la hūm̐ thim/ hūm̐ gi mthar sngags 'phreng 'khod par bsam la/ sngags kyi rjes bzlos lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la dang / bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ rjes gtso bos sogs bya// ༈ /rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i steng du mañdzi'i khar bum pa bcud kyis gang ba dang / mthar mchod gtor dang / spro na bgegs gtor bshams/

de nas slob dpon gyis skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing kha g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha sogs yang snying nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bzlas/ mdun gyi maṇḍal la dmigs nas bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūm̐/ bum pa'i nang du yang pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ gnyis ka yongs su gyur pa las mdun bskyed dang / bum nang gnyis char du rdo rje rnam 'joms sngar bshad pa bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas so so la bstim/ oṃ badzra bid dha ra sa pa ri wa re sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma yang byin brlabs la/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ de nas bum nang gi lha la dmigs nas/ na maḥtsanḍa sogs yang snying brgya la sogs pa bzla/ de'i tshe dmigs pa la bum nang gi lha'i sku lus thams cad las sngags phreng rang sgra sgrog pa dpag tu med pa 'u ru ru 'phros/ bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ de nas 'jug pa'i maṇḍal nas bzung / dbang bzhi pa'i bar bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ de nas slob ma bos la/ phyag dang yon phul nas gral la 'khod pa la/ bgegs gtor bsngos nas gtor ma phyir bskyur ba dang bgegs bskrad/

'o sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs dang / 'jug pa'i maṇḍal gsol btab nas bzung / dbang bzhi pa'i bar lha sngags brje ba ma gtogs phyag rdor ji lta ba bzhin bya/ de nas na maḥtsanḍa sogs brjod cing bum pa thogs la/ bum nang gi lha yang 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med pa des lus thams cad bkrus pas khyed rang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying brjod cing gdong la sogs pa bkru/ mthar hub re 'thung du gzhug rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ 'di la 'jug pa lung tsam la brten/ byin rlabs 'di bsam sdings pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung / 'di rmi lam gyi khrid kyi skabs su gnang na 'brel chags te rmi lam 'di grib la bdar bas de sel byed kyi thabs su 'gro/ gsang sgrub bka' lngar byas na spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub dang / dbon ston skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnyis bsnan pas lngar 'gro ba yin no/ /de ltar gsang sgrub gsum gyi lag len khrigs chags 'di ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung rgyun gyi tho yig la brten/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis lcags 'brug zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin mdar grang chen chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla brang gi dbang khang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 ngag dbang chos grags/ shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
